# Interaction & UX Requirements Quality Checklist: Soil Health Visualization

**Purpose**: Validate completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and coverage of interaction and UX requirements — tooltips, hoe feedback, configuration UX, accessibility, unknown data handling, and multiplayer/split-screen rendering
**Created**: 2026-09-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md) | [research.md](../research.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Tooltip Requirements

- [x] CHK001 Are tooltip positioning requirements specified with exact offset values (16px) and direction (bottom-right diagonal from cursor)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK002 Is the tooltip throttle interval quantified with a specific millisecond value (50ms) and clearly distinguished from the immediate update on new tile entry? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, SC-004] — RESOLVED (clarify 2026-09-13): per-tile throttle scope; FR-015 verification example corrected to match
- [x] CHK003 Are unknown data tooltip requirements consistent across hover (FR-002), hoe feedback (FR-003), and data model (TooltipData format rules)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003, data-model.md]
- [x] CHK004 Is the tooltip rendering event explicitly specified (Display.Rendered) and is this consistent with the requirement that tooltips must render above HUD elements and not be obscured? [Clarity, Consistency, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK005 Are tooltip disappearance requirements specified for all cursor-leave scenarios: moving to a non-tilled tile, moving outside game world bounds, and opening a game menu? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002, §FR-022]
- [x] CHK006 Is the tooltip format string explicitly specified for both known values ("Soil Health: {percentage}% ({category})") and unknown values ("Soil Health: Unknown")? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Clarifications, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK007 Are tooltip background and text color requirements specified to ensure readability against varied game backgrounds? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, data-model.md] — REVIEW: TooltipData defines BackgroundColor/TextColor fields but no values, defaults, or readability/contrast requirement

## Hoe Feedback Requirements

- [x] CHK008 Are the flash duration (300ms) and floating text duration (1000ms) both quantified with specific millisecond values? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK009 Is the rapid-hoe-usage restart behavior specified for both flash and floating text independently (each resets to full duration, no stacking)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, User Story 3 Acceptance Scenario 5, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK010 Are floating text visual style requirements fully specified: color (white), shadow/outline (dark), font (game native), position (tile center), movement (floating upward)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK011 Is the hoe feedback targeting requirement specified to use the local player's cursor position, and is this consistent between single-player, multiplayer, and split-screen contexts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK012 Is the flash effect alpha behavior specified (decreasing from 1.0 to 0.0 over 300ms) and is the color tied to the tile's health category? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, data-model.md]

## Configuration UX Requirements

- [x] CHK013 Are all configurable visualization features explicitly listed: overlays toggle, tooltips toggle, hoe feedback toggle, custom colors per category, opacity, pattern toggle, degradation mode, and HUD anchor offset? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-007, data-model.md]
- [x] CHK014 Is the configuration persistence scope explicitly defined as global (mod-wide) and is this consistent across all config fields and all FRs that reference persistence? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK015 Are configuration fallback requirements specified for each individual field: invalid values replaced with defaults, missing fields receive defaults, unknown fields ignored? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK016 Is the configuration hot-reload timing requirement quantified (within next render frame, ≤16.67ms at 60 FPS)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-005, §FR-019, SC-003]
- [x] CHK017 Is the opacity configuration range explicitly bounded (0.0–1.0) and is the default value (0.3) specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, data-model.md]

## Accessibility Requirements

- [x] CHK018 Are accessibility pattern minimum size requirements quantified: stripes ≥4px wide, dots ≥4px diameter, ≥4px spacing between dots? [Measurability, Spec §FR-001, data-model.md]
- [x] CHK019 Is the pattern opacity floor (minimum 0.7) specified independently from the configurable overlay opacity setting? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK020 Are WCAG 1.4.11 non-text contrast ratio requirements (3:1) specified for white accessibility patterns against all category colors (Poor red, Moderate yellow, Healthy green)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK021 Is the degradation notification UX fully specified: chat message content, HUD indicator appearance, positioning (top-right), anchor offset configurability, and dismissibility behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK022 Are degradation mode options fully enumerated ("auto", "never", "notify") with explicit behavior differences for each? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, data-model.md]

## Unknown Data UX Requirements

- [x] CHK023 Is the unknown data overlay color specified with an exact hex value (#808080) and is this consistent across overlay rendering, tooltip display, and hoe feedback flash? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003, §FR-014, data-model.md]
- [x] CHK024 Are unknown data tooltip requirements specified to omit the percentage, and is this consistent with the hoe feedback floating text format for unknown tiles? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK025 Is the distinction between "no recorded data" (unknown/gray) and "0% health" (Poor/red) explicitly required in visualization behavior, and is the auto-refresh trigger specified (SaveLoaded or data-ready event)? [Clarity, Coverage, Spec §FR-014, Clarifications]

## Multiplayer/Split-Screen UX Requirements

- [x] CHK026 Are per-player rendering requirements specified for all visualization features: overlays, tooltips, hoe feedback, and degradation state tracking? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003, §FR-009, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK027 Is the cursor-to-tile mapping requirement specified for split-screen contexts where each local player has an independent cursor and viewport? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK028 Are degradation threshold requirements specified to count visible tiles per-player independently in split-screen, with degradation applying only to the player who exceeded 1,000 tiles? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK029 Is the rendering event behavior for split-screen explicitly specified (Display.RenderedWorld fires once per player per frame with Game1 state already swapped to current player)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, research.md]
- [x] CHK030 Is the PerScreen<T> pattern requirement specified for tracking per-player state (degradation flags, notification sent flags, feedback state) in split-screen contexts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, data-model.md, research.md]
